title: Soil sensor paani nahi napta, sirf ye napta hai 🌱 #shorts
description:
Tumhara plant bol nahi sakta, phir smart pot ko kaise pata chalta hai?
Sensor paani nahi, sirf resistance naapta hai!
🌱 Resistive soil sensor ka 3D teardown
⚡ LM393 comparator, AO aur DO pins
📈 850 dry, 400 wet, 750 se upar = paani do
🔧 Pin 7 se power do, probe corrosion kam karo
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ke liye, roz ek naya sensor kholke dekhenge!
